# Benefit Builder LLC

> Texas-based Section 125 cafeteria plan administrator. We help employers cut FICA payroll tax, raise employee take-home pay, and stay IRS-compliant with bundled plan documents, NDT, and payroll integration.

Founded 2019, family-run, headquartered in Willis, TX. Serves employers and brokers nationwide. All-inclusive monthly fee, no surprise costs.

## What we do

- Section 125 Premium Only Plan (POP) administration
- FICA savings analysis for employers
- Non-discrimination testing (NDT)
- Plan documents, adoption agreements, salary reduction agreements
- Payroll integration and roster sync
- HSA and FSA administration
- Supplemental benefits: life, accident, critical illness, disability, gap
- Broker partnership program

## Service areas

Benefit Builder administers Section 125 plans across nine states, with savings detail specific to each state's income tax.

- [Service Areas](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations): Hub for all states and cities
- [Missouri](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/missouri): Flat 4.7% state income tax; cities include Cape Girardeau, Poplar Bluff, Festus
- [Texas](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/texas): No state income tax; home state; cities include Conroe, Houston, Baytown, Laredo
- [Oklahoma](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/oklahoma): Bracketed up to 4.75%; Durant
- [New Mexico](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/new-mexico): Bracketed 1.7% to 5.9%; Farmington and the Four Corners
- [Ohio](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/ohio): Flat 3.5%; Dayton
- [Michigan](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/michigan): Flat 4.05%; Southfield and the Detroit metro
- [Colorado](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/colorado): Flat 4.4%; Centennial and the Denver metro
- [Illinois](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/illinois): Flat 4.95%
- [Georgia](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/georgia): Flat 5.39%
